name: COMP_002
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (62%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Low reliability, a {Benign, InSitu} conformal set, and frozen-section status warrant deferral to permanent sections.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 62%, Benign 33%, Invasive 3%, Normal 2% [F1] | InSitu leads; Benign remains plausible |
| Conformal set | {Benign, InSitu} at 90% target (90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate InSitu from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 84% OOD, AUROC 0.70 [F6] | Unreliable input; high OOD score |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (same_top: false) | Independent backbones disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 20% match (1/5 InSitu; 2 Benign, 1 Invasive, 1 Normal) [F5] | Weak reference consensus for InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.90); unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical (+0.64); descriptive only, 8/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.34), pushes away from invasion (20/20 check) [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.26); unreliable 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Elevated (+0.23), pushes toward invasion (19/20 check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unfaithful vs random (+0.001, 95% CI -0.009–0.006); case leans on unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20 checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Artifacts on this low-reliability (32%) simulated frozen section mask a benign lesion (33% probability; top neighbor BACH_0384 is Benign).
- High-risk region 2 (84% invasive risk) or unsampled deeper levels harbor focal invasion missed by the 3% risk score.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 2** (84% invasive risk) and **region 8** (infiltrating stroma): inspect for true stromal invasion.
2. **Region 1** and **region 0**: evaluate ductal atypia versus tubules; consider drafted recut and deeper levels.
3. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: verify benign stroma (lobules score is unreliable) and defer frozen margins [F7].
